competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times and deals damage proportionate to your Defense. Each attack has a 45% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn. If the target is not suffering any harmful effects, 1 additional attack is added. In addition, recovers your HP by 20% of the damage dealt.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
effets.note: If the target is not suffering any harmful effects

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill

competences.description: Unleashes a devastating shout to provoke all enemies for 1 turn with a 75% chance.

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: Your Defense is increased by 25% for every beneficial effect granted on yourself and your Attack Speed is increased by 25 for every harmful effect you suffer. In addition, your Attack Bar increases by 20% whenever you're granted with beneficial or harmful effects. The Attack Bar increase does not apply to the effects you receive at the start of the battle. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's defense will be increased by 70%.
The target's Attack Speed will be increased by 30%.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: Whenever you're granted with beneficial or harmful effects
